# HealthDB

> Synthetic-data oncology research workflow pilot. Not for clinical use or real patient data.

## Public entry points
- Human demo: https://www.healthdb.ai/demo
- Developer quickstart: https://www.healthdb.ai/developers
- OpenAPI: https://www.healthdb.ai/api/openapi.json
- Capabilities: https://www.healthdb.ai/api/capabilities
- Health: https://www.healthdb.ai/api/health

## Try without authentication
POST https://www.healthdb.ai/api/demo/cohort/build
Content-Type: application/json
{"cancer_types":["Multiple Myeloma"],"age_min":50}

Fixture version 1: 4 matching fictional profiles, 16 records, 24 total profiles.
This endpoint uses deterministic fixtures, never the patient database.
It accepts CohortCriteria as defined in OpenAPI. Unsupported input returns 422.
All inclusion rules must match; any matching exclusion removes a profile.
Missing data does not establish a negative finding. Stage matching is exact.
No results should be interpreted as real patients, clinical recommendations, or business traction.

## Private workflows
Invited accounts only. Bearer tokens and role authorization are required.
Do not put credentials in URLs or public browser code.
Exports require selected fields, current approvals and eligible consented records.
Only CSV pilot exports are implemented. No production EHR integration or MCP server is offered.
